definitions: To grant full citizenship to a foreigner.
To introduce (an animal or plant) into a region where it is not indigenous and where it then flourishes.
To adopt (a foreign word or custom) into a language or culture.
To make natural or normal; to explain or interpret in terms of natural causes.
examples: The government will naturalize many immigrants this year.
They attempted to naturalize the new species in the local ecosystem.
Many foreign words have been naturalized into English.
The philosopher sought to naturalize moral concepts.
pastTenses: naturalized (simple past), naturalized (present perfect), naturalized (past perfect)
